Attached: 1 image

Want a peek at Uptime Herald before its public release? The demo site is already live and running real monitors, so you can see the dashboard & monitor stats.

https://demo.uptimeherald.org/

There's a kiosk view too for wall displays:
                                                                                             
https://demo.uptimeherald.org/kiosk/

Self-hosted. No user accounts. Deploy with Docker, configure in YAML. Open source / AGPL license.

#selfhosted #homelab #monitoring #opensource
